title: Blygger manifest — blyg.json
description: Reader-acceptance schema for the manifest (spec 6.1). The manifest filename is protocol-fixed; the mount is free (spec 4).

generator.description: name/version; informative; readers MUST NOT gate on it (spec 3.2).

generator_url.description: One absolute URL to the client's source/home; informative (spec 6.1).

site.description: Self-asserted, display-advisory only; never establishes identity (spec 6.1, 12.2).

author.description: Publication identity (imprint), distinct from per-item author (byline) (spec 6.1).

blogroll.description: OPTIONAL; present only when a non-empty blogroll is served (spec 6.1, 11).

webmention.description: OPTIONAL; present only when the publisher receives mentions (spec 6.1, 15.1).

notes: feed/items default to feed.xml and items/index.json when absent; a blyg that omits blogroll/webmention serves neither.
blogroll and webmention keys are present only when the corresponding surface is actually served.
